title: Hallucinated quantity-correction confirmation is blocked, not shown to the customer
notes: The actual production bug this guards against: a quantity correction ('No the coke is going to be 3 cokes not one') has none of ORDER_ADD's trigger words, so intent_router returns None/UNKNOWN -- outside the _ORDER_INTENTS set the earlier mutation guard checks. If the LLM then returns a non-mutating action (chitchat) with a prose 'confirmation' describing a cart state that was never actually applied, the customer used to see that fake total while the real cart (and the eventual persisted order) stayed unchanged -- exactly what was reported against the real Mochachos order BO-000001. This fixture scripts that exact failure mode and asserts the new guard (pipeline.py's catch-all chitchat block) intercepts it: the cart stays at quantity 1, and the customer is asked to restate the change rather than shown a fabricated total.

turns.message: I'll have a Classic Smash Burger, Chips and a Coke
No the coke is going to be 3 cokes not one
